reason: This workflow used GitHub Copilot CLI implementation and review agents. The assessment agent policy permits only Gemini and Qwen, so this file must not be submitted as agentic-loop assessment evidence.

plan.goal: Make the Student Course homepage easier to understand by organising it around finding, reviewing, checking and enrolling in a Course.
primaryUserJourney: Find a Course through the catalogue or search.
Enrol only when the Course and enrolment state are valid.
approvedDirection: Make the Course catalogue the primary workspace.
Replace homepage navigation tabs with filters inside the catalogue.
Keep Course AI available but collapsed until needed.
Keep official enrolments owned by Academic Records.

act.implementationAgent: GitHub Copilot CLI powered by GPT-5.6 Sol
changes: Added Student filters for All, Enrolled and Not enrolled inside the Course catalogue.
Added Staff filters for All, Active and Inactive inside the Course catalogue.
Changed Course AI to a compact expandable assistant.
Displayed AI context checkboxes only while Course AI is open.
Reduced Student catalogue actions to View and Enrol.
Kept prerequisite eligibility inside Course details.
Aligned the enrolled metric with Courses available in the Course Management catalogue.
Integrated Student enrolment summaries through the Academic Records API.
Added Course catalogue validation before creating an official enrolment.

observe.reviewAgent: GitHub Copilot CLI read-only code-review agent
observe.reviewScope: Uncommitted Student 2 Course homepage and enrolment integration changes

findings.finding: An Academic Records failure was treated as confirmation that every Course was not enrolled.
findings.risk: The UI could show incorrect status, enable the Not enrolled filter and offer Enrol while the real state was unknown.

findings.finding: The enrolment endpoint accepted Course codes that were missing or inactive in Course Management.
findings.risk: A stale or direct request could create an official Academic Records enrolment for an unavailable Course.

findings.finding: Course AI was unavailable when the Course catalogue was empty or failed to load.
findings.risk: The implementation did not consistently provide the intended permanent homepage AI entry point.

findings.finding: A duplicated error condition in the outer Razor branch skipped all content after the dashboard header when Course loading succeeded.
findings.risk: The APIs returned valid data, but Students and Staff could not see metrics, Course AI or the Course catalogue.

observe.interpretation: The build proved that the code compiled, but the independent review found business-rule and workflow defects that compilation could not detect.

changes: Represented unavailable enrolment information separately from Not enrolled.
Disabled enrolment-dependent filters and actions when Academic Records data is unavailable.
Validated that a Course exists and is active before forwarding an enrolment to Academic Records.
Kept the compact Course AI entry point available when the catalogue is empty or unavailable.
Added regression tests for Course catalogue lookup and inactive or unknown Course enrolment rejection.
Replaced the incorrect outer else-if condition so successful Course loads render the full homepage.

checksAfterAdaptation.result: HTTP 200 from the Course Management backend
HTTP 404 returned without creating an Academic Records enrolment
A fresh headless Edge profile rendered 10 Courses, catalogue filters, enrolment metrics and the collapsed Course AI assistant from http://localhost:8082

humanReflection.prompt: Why was passing the tests not enough to prove that the implementation was correct?
humanReflection.response: because the tests were created by the same agent that implemented the code changes. These tests are there to test whether the agents code changes are working correctly. However, it doesn't mean the implementation is right, it is only perceived and judege by one agent that thinks its right. Asking another agent to review the implemented code can provide more insight and transparency on other alternative solutions

contextManagement.reason: The repository source remained local. Gemini was not used as the code-review agent for this cycle.
contextManagement.reviewSeparation: The implementation and review roles were performed by separate Copilot CLI agent contexts.

knownLimitations: Academic Records does not currently publish an unenrolment endpoint.
The teaching period used for enrolment is configured by Student 2 instead of selected by the Student.
The current PowerShell loop sends deterministic pass or fail evidence to Gemini but does not ask Gemini to inspect repository source code.
